title: Identification of a Novel Biomarker based Peripheral Blood Mononuclear Cells Gene Expression for Diagnosis and Prognosis of Hepatocellular Carcinoma
description: We performed transcriptome analyses on peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) from HCC patients and PBMCs co-cultured with HCC to investigate the common differentially expressed genes (DEGs) between these transcription profiles.
